Update one binding by its stable ID, preserving the asset's other IDs/references. Requires confirm; dry_run previews. Writes .inputactions through Input System JSON and synchronously imports. Not undoable.

Add/edit native horizontal, vertical or grid layout with Undo. Same type preserves unspecified settings; changing type requires replace=true. Does not force layout rebuild.

Set sibling order and/or an explicit Canvas sorting layer/order with Undo. No inferred global draw ranking, no save. Sorting fields require a Canvas on the target itself.

Edit shape/gradient/border/texture/material with one Undo. Omitted settings stay unchanged. Invalid final geometry rolls the complete edit back.
Add/edit UniversalAdditionalCameraData with Undo. Typed post-processing, AA, textures, volume mask/trigger and validated Base-to-Overlay stack. Does not change project pipeline.

Add/edit a typed native Volume override and save this explicit shared Profile. Bloom/color/vignette/tonemapping/DOF/chromatic/lens distortion/motion blur. All supplied fields validated; omitted parameters and override states preserved.

Explicitly apply or restore a runtime global driver in Play Mode. Reapply requires releasing the current lease first. Not Undo.

Play/pause/stop/seek/evaluate a native Director in stable Play Mode only. Uses its native clock; seek evaluates at an explicit finite time. Not Undo; stop uses Timeline's native restoration semantics.

Create a new ScriptableObject (or other UnityEngine.Object) asset of the given type at a path under the authoring root.

Switch a live PlayerInput to an existing action map; Play Mode only. Does not change the asset or project input backend.
Change PlayerSettings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z. Scripting backend / API level changes trigger a domain reload.
Change QualitySettings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.

Change Pipeline Runtime settings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z. Refused while in Play Mode: the running driver already loaded its own settings, so a change would silently not apply until the next Play session or build. port, requestTimeoutMs, and maxWorkItemsPerFrame are rejected outright if outside the same bounds the Project Settings page enforces.
Set the Editor selection to the given assets/scene objects.
Set a serialized field on a component/asset. Supports primitives, enums, Vector/Color/Rect/Bounds,

Apply a temporary typed global scope after validating all entries. Returns scope ID; restore/Play transition/reload returns compatible keys to baseline. Observable different external writes are preserved. Not Undo or persistent.
Set temporary typed parameters on an active bridge-owned material in Play Mode, preserving them across Rect/mask rebuilds. Does not edit assets or feature keywords; no save/Undo.
Set a GameObject's tag (the tag must already exist in the project).
Add/remove tags and assign user layer names (index 8-31). Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.
Set the target frame rate for the application
Change Time settings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.
Set the time scale for the application
Set TMP_InputField text/read-only state with Undo. Value-change notification defaults off; does not emulate typing or submit.
Set TMP display text, size and autosizing with Undo; no save or forced layout. Use a subsequent inspect after layout updates.
Set a GameObject's local position/rotation(euler)/scale. Omitted channels are left unchanged.
Set common uGUI control state with Undo. Callback notification is off by default; Button clicks require the input path. Does not save.
Simulate a keyboard key event (Input System). Drives the running app.
Simulate a mouse/pointer event at screen coordinates (Input System).
Run a bounded, real-time key/pointer sequence across normal Input System updates in Play Mode. Own virtual devices; one active sequence. Steps use absolute milliseconds since start.
Start continuous bounded PNG capture without blocking the Editor. Default screen source includes Overlay UI. Poll read_visual_frames during operations; starting capture alone does not start a model.
Stop the named observation; keep its bounded frame evidence. Does not stop Play Mode or alter scenes.
Switch the active build target (destructive, long-running: triggers a full reimport + domain
Status of the last target switch: idle | switching | completed (with success + activeBuildTarget).
Get status of running async test execution
Unpack a prefab instance into plain GameObjects (outermost level or completely).
Cancel an async wait started with wait_for (async=true).

Wait server-side until a member condition holds, then optionally act in the same frame. Sync waits hold the exec queue (every other command waits behind them, including one the condition may depend on) — keep them short and self-contained; set async=true and poll wait_status for anything else.
Get the status/result of an async wait started with wait_for (async=true).
Write UTF-8 text to a file under the authoring root, then import it. Overwriting an existing file requires confirm=true.
